detail.title: In It Together: How Company Performance Transmits Through Supply Chains

publicationDetails.detailsText: S&P Global Market Intelligence Quantamental Report - December 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: S&P Global Market Intelligence Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Supply chains transmit information before markets price it. Customer performance reveals emerging demand, and supplier performance reveals capacity and execution risk. These directional spillovers move through networks in predictable ways. When customers are getting stronger, suppliers see order flow and revenue visibility improve. When suppliers are stable and delivering reliably, customers maintain margins and avoid operational bottlenecks. Both channels matter. When both directions turn positive at the same time, the effect compounds: companies benefit from improving demand and a supply base capable of supporting it.

AI.tldr: 供应链在市场价格形成前传递信息，客户表现揭示新兴需求，供应商表现揭示产能和执行风险，这些定向溢出效应在供应链网络中可预测地传播，当客户和供应商表现同时改善时会产生复合效应。
AI.research_question: 供应链网络中的信息传递如何影响企业绩效？具体而言，客户表现和供应商表现如何通过供应链网络产生定向溢出效应，以及这些效应如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 传统市场定价模型未能充分捕捉供应链中的信息传递机制，而供应链参与者在市场价格形成前就拥有关于需求、产能和风险的关键信息，理解这些信息如何通过供应链网络传播对预测企业绩效至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链信息传递理论、网络溢出效应、需求信号理论、供应链风险管理、信息经济学、网络效应理论
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证研究，可能使用供应链网络数据、企业绩效数据、时间序列分析来检验客户和供应商表现对企业绩效的预测能力
AI.findings: 1. 客户表现改善预示着供应商订单流和收入可见性提升；2. 供应商稳定可靠有助于客户维持利润率和避免运营瓶颈；3. 两个方向的溢出效应都很重要；4. 当客户和供应商表现同时改善时，会产生复合效应，企业受益于需求改善和供应基础的支持能力
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了供应链信息传递的理论框架；2. 识别了供应链网络中定向溢出效应的机制；3. 提出了客户-供应商双向信息传递的复合效应理论；4. 扩展了网络效应理论在供应链环境中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供了通过监控供应链伙伴表现来预测自身绩效的工具；2. 帮助管理者识别供应链网络中的风险与机会；3. 为投资决策提供基于供应链信息的早期信号；4. 优化供应链关系管理策略

title: Marriage Increases Women's Unpaid Care Work by 44%, Men's Unchanged: Evidence from India
affiliations: Apna.Co

detail.title: Marriage Increases Women's Unpaid Care Work by 44%, Men's Unchanged: Evidence from India
detail.abstract: Using India's 2024 Time Use Survey (10.2 million observations, 139,489 households), we document a stark marriage penalty in unpaid care work: marriage increases women's care work participation by 2.1 percentage points (44% increase) while having zero effect on men's participation. This penalty is 2.4 times larger for younger women (25) than older women (>25), and persists across all education levels, urban-rural locations, and employment status. We find no gender difference in time intensity conditional on participation, indicating the disparity operates entirely on the participation margin. These findings reveal marriage as a critical institution activating gender-specific norms about domestic responsibilities, with important implications for policies targeting gender equality in household production.

AI.tldr: 基于印度2024年时间使用调查数据，研究发现婚姻对女性无偿照料工作存在显著惩罚效应：婚姻使女性参与照料工作的概率增加2.1个百分点（增幅44%），而对男性无影响。这种惩罚效应在年轻女性中更为严重，且在不同教育水平、城乡和就业状况中普遍存在。
AI.research_question: 婚姻如何影响男女在无偿照料工作参与上的性别差异？婚姻惩罚效应在不同年龄、教育水平、城乡和就业状况的女性中是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 理解婚姻作为社会制度如何塑造家庭内部的性别分工，特别是对无偿照料工作的影响，这对于制定促进家庭生产性别平等的政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别角色理论、婚姻制度理论、家庭分工理论、社会规范理论
AI.method: 使用印度2024年时间使用调查数据（1020万观测值，139,489个家庭），通过统计分析方法研究婚姻对男女无偿照料工作参与的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 婚姻使女性照料工作参与率增加2.1个百分点（增幅44%），对男性无影响；2. 年轻女性（≤25岁）的婚姻惩罚是年长女性（>25岁）的2.4倍；3. 这种效应在所有教育水平、城乡和就业状况中普遍存在；4. 参与后时间强度无性别差异，说明差异完全来自参与门槛。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了婚姻作为激活性别特定规范的关键制度机制，深化了对家庭内部性别分工形成机制的理解，特别是婚姻如何强化女性在无偿照料工作中的责任。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定促进家庭生产性别平等的政策提供实证依据，特别是针对年轻女性的政策干预，强调需要挑战婚姻相关的性别规范来减少无偿照料工作的性别不平等。

title: Managing Democracy in a Fragile Political Landscape: Assessing the Capacity of Lesotho’s Electoral Commission to Foster Integrity, Inclusivity, and Public Trust

detail.title: Managing Democracy in a Fragile Political Landscape: Assessing the Capacity of Lesotho’s Electoral Commission to Foster Integrity, Inclusivity, and Public Trust
detail.abstract: The Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) of Lesotho has administered national elections since 1997 in a fragile political environment characterized by recurring coalition instability, contested processes, and declining public confidence. The 2022 General Elections, marked by the country's lowest-ever voter turnout at 37.7 percent, highlighted persistent structural challenges in electoral governance. Allegations of inaccuracies in the voter register and the underrepresentation of youth raised concerns about electoral integrity. The late adjustment of constituency boundaries further undermined public trust. Barriers faced by women and persons with disabilities revealed critical shortcomings in inclusivity and equitable participation. This paper critically assesses the IEC's capacity to foster integrity, inclusivity, and public trust within such a volatile context. Drawing on electoral data, observer reports, and the legal framework, the analysis demonstrates that while the Commission broadly complies with its statutory mandate, systemic weaknesses in voter registration, civic and voter education, and inter-agency coordination continue to erode legitimacy. To address these gaps, two reform priorities are emphasized. First, the institutionalization of robust and continuous civic and voter education, particularly targeting youth, women, and marginalized groups. Second, the enhancement of the voter register's accuracy and inclusiveness through sustained cross-institutional collaboration. By situating the Lesotho case within broader debates on democratic resilience, the paper highlights the dual role of election management bodies as both technical administrators and guardians of democratic legitimacy in fragile political landscapes.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估莱索托独立选举委员会在脆弱政治环境中促进选举公正性、包容性和公众信任的能力，指出系统性弱点并提出两项改革重点。
AI.research_question: 莱索托独立选举委员会在脆弱政治环境中如何促进选举公正性、包容性和公众信任？
AI.motivation: 莱索托2022年大选创下历史最低投票率（37.7%），暴露出选民登记不准确、青年代表性不足、选区边界调整滞后等问题，凸显选举治理的结构性挑战和公众信任危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主韧性理论框架，探讨选举管理机构在脆弱政治环境中作为技术管理者和民主合法性守护者的双重角色。
AI.method: 基于选举数据、观察员报告和法律框架的批判性分析，评估IEC的法定职责履行情况和系统性弱点。
AI.findings: IEC基本遵守法定职责，但选民登记、公民和选民教育、跨机构协调等方面的系统性弱点持续侵蚀选举合法性；妇女和残疾人面临参与障碍，包容性不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将莱索托案例置于民主韧性辩论中，强调选举管理机构在脆弱政治环境中既是技术管理者又是民主合法性守护者的双重角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两项改革重点：1）制度化强健且持续的公民和选民教育（特别针对青年、妇女和边缘群体）；2）通过持续跨机构合作提高选民登记的准确性和包容性。

title: Breaking the Low-Level Equilibrium: A Two-sided Approach to Household Waste Segregation in Bangladesh
affiliations: Bennett University and Wageningen University and Research (WUR) - Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: Breaking the Low-Level Equilibrium: A Two-sided Approach to Household Waste Segregation in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Developing countries are often trapped in a low-level equilibrium in waste segregation, where households and waste collectors lack sufficient incentives to alter their practices. In this study, we examine a combined intervention approach from both the household side and the collection side. Specifically, we conducted an experiment in Mymensingh, Bangladesh with three treatment conditions: (1) information only, (2) information plus a bucket, and (3) information plus plastic bags—all alongside a segregated collection service. We find that an intervention that combines a one-time information campaign with a segregated collection service can increase the household waste segregation rate by 30 percentage points. Supplementing information provision with either buckets or plastic bags can further improve waste segregation. Furthermore, we show that the improved household waste segregation benefits the downstream waste processing plant. Our results demonstrate that policies integrating collection-side and household-side interventions could initiate a transition toward sustainable waste management in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验发现，在孟加拉国Mymensingh地区，结合信息宣传和分类收集服务的干预措施可将家庭垃圾分类率提高30个百分点，而提供垃圾桶或塑料袋能进一步改善分类效果，这种综合干预有助于发展中国家向可持续废物管理转型。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家如何打破垃圾分类的低水平均衡？结合家庭端和收集端的综合干预措施能否有效提高家庭垃圾分类率？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家在垃圾分类方面常常陷入低水平均衡，家庭和垃圾收集者都缺乏改变行为的足够激励，需要探索有效的干预策略来打破这种困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和制度理论，关注发展中国家垃圾分类中的激励不足问题，探讨如何通过综合干预打破低水平均衡。
AI.method: 在孟加拉国Mymensingh进行随机对照实验，设置三个处理组：(1)仅提供信息，(2)信息+垃圾桶，(3)信息+塑料袋，所有组都配合分类收集服务，对照组为常规处理。
AI.findings: 1. 信息宣传结合分类收集服务可将家庭垃圾分类率提高30个百分点；2. 在信息基础上提供垃圾桶或塑料袋能进一步改善分类效果；3. 改善的家庭垃圾分类对下游废物处理厂也有积极影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家垃圾分类的低水平均衡问题提供了实证证据，展示了如何通过综合干预打破这种均衡，丰富了行为经济学在环境管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可行的干预方案：结合信息宣传、物质支持（垃圾桶/塑料袋）和分类收集服务的综合策略，能够有效推动发展中国家向可持续废物管理转型。

title: The Role of Persistent Climate-Driven Financial Effects in Estimating Climate Damages through Integrated Assessment Models
affiliations: University of Bergen and Kristiania University College

detail.title: The Role of Persistent Climate-Driven Financial Effects in Estimating Climate Damages through Integrated Assessment Models

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Horizon Europe research and innovation programs under grant agreement no. 101081661 (WorldTrans). This work used resources of the Deutsches Klimarechenzentrum (DKRZ) granted by its Scientific Steering Committee (WLA) under project IDs 0033 and 1275.

detail.abstract: Integrated Assessment Models (IAMs) are essential for analyzing the long-term economic consequences of climate change, yet their climate damage functions remain a primary source of uncertainty and critique. Current e[orts focus on disaggregating immediate biophysical impacts, often overlooking or simplifying financial feedback loops. This paper introduces a novel, climate-driven financial damage channel into a new IAM, FRIDA v2.1, specifically focusing on the relationship between climate change and increased nonperforming loans. We characterize this financial damage as a time-dependent, inertial e[ect, impairing the financial sector's ability to support investments in the long term. The results demonstrate that incorporating this persistent financial channel leads to significantly higher estimates of long-term economic damage compared to DICE style aggregate climate damage functions. These findings underscore the necessity for IAMs to explicitly model persistent, climate-driven financial feedback mechanisms to accurately capture long-term climate risk and provide robust guidance for mitigation policy.

AI.tldr: 该论文将气候驱动的金融损害渠道引入综合评估模型(FRIDA v2.1)，重点关注气候变化与不良贷款增加的关系，发现这种持续性金融反馈机制会显著提高长期经济损害估计
AI.research_question: 如何在综合评估模型中纳入气候驱动的金融损害渠道，特别是气候变化与不良贷款增加的关系，以及这种金融反馈机制对长期经济损害估计的影响？
AI.motivation: 当前综合评估模型的气候损害函数存在较大不确定性，主要关注生物物理影响而忽视或简化金融反馈循环，需要更准确地捕捉长期气候风险
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合评估模型理论、气候经济学、金融风险传导机制、时间依赖性惯性效应理论
AI.method: 开发新的综合评估模型FRIDA v2.1，引入气候驱动的金融损害渠道，特别关注气候变化与不良贷款增加的关系，将金融损害建模为时间依赖性惯性效应
AI.findings: 纳入持续性金融渠道会导致长期经济损害估计显著高于传统DICE风格的综合气候损害函数
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了气候驱动的金融损害渠道理论框架，将金融部门受损作为时间依赖性惯性效应纳入气候经济模型，丰富了综合评估模型的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更准确的气候风险评估工具，强调需要在IAMs中明确建模持续性金融反馈机制，为减缓政策提供更稳健的指导

title: Overlapping Community Detection in Mixed Membership Vector Autoregression

detail.title: Overlapping Community Detection in Mixed Membership Vector Autoregression
detail.abstract: In this work, we introduce a novel cluster affiliation vector autoregressive model, termed the mixed membership stochastic block vector autoregression (MMSB-VAR(p)). This model assumes that the VAR coefficients at all lags are random matrices following a joint distribution defined by a probabilistic generative framework. The panel data generated by this model can exhibit either single or multiple membership structures with the estimated VAR coefficients recovering the corresponding non-overlapping or overlapping block structures. To uncover the latent group structure, we propose a two-step algorithm leveraging the key insight that spillover effects within groups are significantly stronger than those between groups. We establish the consistency of the proposed algorithm and the simulation study demonstrates its effectiveness. Finally, we apply our methodology to analyze public opinions about the Ukraine-Russia war on Reddit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的混合隶属随机块向量自回归模型（MMSB-VAR(p)），用于分析具有潜在分组结构的面板数据。该模型假设所有滞后的VAR系数都是遵循概率生成框架定义的联合分布的随机矩阵，能够捕捉单隶属或多隶属结构。作者提出了一种基于组内溢出效应显著强于组间效应的两步算法来识别潜在分组结构，并证明了算法的理论一致性。最后将该方法应用于分析Reddit上关于乌克兰-俄罗斯战争的公众意见。
AI.research_question: 如何从具有潜在分组结构的面板数据中识别和估计混合隶属的随机块向量自回归关系？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的面板数据（如社交媒体意见、经济指标等）往往存在潜在的分组结构，传统VAR模型无法有效捕捉这种结构。特别是在多主体交互系统中，个体可能同时属于多个组，需要能够处理重叠隶属关系的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合隶属随机块模型（MMSB）与向量自回归（VAR）的结合，构建了MMSB-VAR(p)框架。该框架假设VAR系数矩阵遵循由潜在分组结构定义的联合概率分布。
AI.method: 提出两步算法：1）基于组内溢出效应显著强于组间效应的关键洞察，识别潜在分组结构；2）在识别分组结构的基础上估计VAR参数。通过模拟研究验证算法有效性，并建立理论一致性证明。
AI.findings: 模拟研究表明所提算法能有效识别潜在分组结构并准确估计VAR参数。在Reddit乌克兰-俄罗斯战争意见分析中，成功识别出具有不同观点倾向的用户群体及其动态交互模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将混合隶属随机块模型与VAR框架结合，提出MMSB-VAR(p)模型；2）建立了基于溢出效应差异的分组识别算法理论；3）证明了算法的统计一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为分析具有复杂分组结构的面板数据提供新工具；2）在社交媒体意见分析中能识别重叠隶属关系；3）可用于政策分析、市场细分、社会网络研究等多个领域。

title: Political Identity and Consumer Behavior: Musk and Tesla in Germany
affiliations: and ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research

detail.title: Political Identity and Consumer Behavior: Musk and Tesla in Germany
detail.abstract: We examine how Elon Musk's public endorsement of Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) in December 2024 affected Tesla sales. Using district-level monthly registration data and a difference-indifferences design, we show that new Tesla registrations increased by up to 30% in right-leaning regions but stagnated or declined in left-leaning ones. Event-study estimates indicate no pre-trends but a persistent post-event divergence. The effect does not extend to other electric vehicle brands. The results demonstrate that corporate political influence can polarize consumer demand along partisan lines.

AI.tldr: 特斯拉CEO马斯克公开支持德国极右翼政党AfD后，特斯拉在右倾地区销量增长30%，在左倾地区销量停滞或下降，显示企业政治立场会按党派路线极化消费者需求。
AI.research_question: 马斯克公开支持德国极右翼政党AfD如何影响特斯拉在德国不同政治倾向地区的销量？
AI.motivation: 研究企业高管公开政治立场对消费者行为的影响，特别是在政治极化日益加剧的背景下，了解企业政治影响力如何塑造市场需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治认同理论、消费者行为理论、企业政治影响力理论、党派极化理论。
AI.method: 使用德国地区级月度注册数据，采用双重差分法设计，比较右倾和左倾地区在马斯克表态前后的特斯拉注册量变化。
AI.findings: 1. 右倾地区特斯拉新注册量增长高达30%；2. 左倾地区特斯拉注册量停滞或下降；3. 事件研究显示无预趋势但存在持续后事件分歧；4. 效应仅限于特斯拉品牌，未扩展到其他电动汽车品牌。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证证明企业政治立场能按党派路线极化消费者需求；2. 扩展了企业政治影响力理论；3. 为政治认同如何影响消费者选择提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 企业高管需谨慎考虑公开政治表态的商业后果；2. 市场营销策略应考虑地区政治倾向差异；3. 为理解品牌政治化现象提供管理启示。

title: Bank Fees and Household Financial Well-Being
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis, Georgia Institute of Technology - Finance Area and Harvard Business School

detail.title: Bank Fees and Household Financial Well-Being
detail.abstract: Even very straightforward policy changes in the provision of consumer nancial services can fail to impact the vulnerable households they would have been expected to benet. In this study, we examine policy changes from large U.S. banks between 2017 and 2022, which eliminated non-sucient funds (NSF) fees and relaxed overdraft policies. Using individual transaction-level data, we nd that the elimination of NSF fees, not surprisingly, resulted in immediate reductions in NSF charges across the income distribution. However, relaxing overdraft policies resulted in reductions in overdraft fees only for wealthier households, along the dimensions of income and liquidity, and only those enjoyed subsequent declines in late fees, interest payments, account maintenance fees, and the use of alternative nancial services, such as payday loans. Our results thus suggest that the policy changes were not substantial enough to signicantly reduce the nancial stress of the more vulnerable households. Finally, as our setting features multiple treatments and variation in treatment intensities, we theoretically motivate and empirically implement a new stacked event study estimator closely related to de de Chaisemartin and D'Haultfoeuille (2024) to address the biases arising from staggered DID specications.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2017-2022年美国大银行取消NSF费用和放宽透支政策的改革效果。研究发现，取消NSF费用确实减少了所有收入阶层的NSF费用，但放宽透支政策仅使富裕家庭受益，未能显著减轻弱势家庭的财务压力。
AI.research_question: 美国大银行取消NSF费用和放宽透支政策的改革对哪些家庭产生了实际影响？这些政策变化是否有效减轻了弱势家庭的财务压力？
AI.motivation: 即使看似直接的政策变化，在实际执行中也可能无法惠及预期受益的弱势家庭。需要实证检验金融政策改革对不同收入群体的实际影响，特别是对财务脆弱家庭的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容性理论和行为金融学，研究政策变化对消费者财务行为的影响机制。同时采用de Chaisemartin和D'Haultfoeuille（2024）的堆叠事件研究估计方法处理交错DID设定中的偏差问题。
AI.method: 使用个人交易层面的数据，采用新的堆叠事件研究估计方法（与de Chaisemartin和D'Haultfoeuille 2024相关），处理多重处理和不同处理强度的交错DID设定偏差。
AI.findings: 1. 取消NSF费用确实减少了所有收入阶层的NSF费用；2. 放宽透支政策仅减少了富裕家庭（按收入和流动性维度）的透支费用；3. 只有富裕家庭随后在滞纳金、利息支付、账户维护费用和使用替代金融服务（如发薪日贷款）方面有所下降；4. 政策变化不足以显著减轻弱势家庭的财务压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为金融政策改革的异质性影响提供了理论解释；2. 发展了处理多重处理和不同处理强度的堆叠事件研究估计方法；3. 揭示了政策表面公平与实际效果之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了金融政策改革的实际效果评估；2. 指出需要更实质性的政策干预才能真正帮助弱势家庭；3. 提供了分析交错政策变化的计量方法工具。

detail.abstract: Bangladesh's health sector faces persistent and deeply rooted challenges, including weak governance, shortage of skilled workforce, inadequate financing, mismanagement of resources, and poor quality of service delivery. Despite notable improvements in maternal and child health indicators over the past decades, the system continues to experience inefficiencies that undermine progress. This article explores these systemic challenges by applying a management point of view, drawing insights from the works of Khaled (2025), who emphasizes the role of strategic planning, institutional discipline, leadership capability, and organizational efficiency in improving government sectors. In addition to identifying major problems, this paper presents a management-oriented roadmap for sustainable health sector reform in Bangladesh. The recommendations are based on practical experiences, academic research, and lessons from public sector management perspectives. By integrating management principles such as accountability, strategic vision, human resource development, and technological innovation, the article aims to offer a structured, implementable solution for strengthening the health system. The expected outcomes include improved service delivery, enhanced governance structures, efficient resource utilization, and greater trust in public healthcare institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文从管理学视角分析孟加拉国卫生系统的系统性挑战，提出基于战略规划、制度纪律、领导能力和组织效率的管理导向改革路线图，旨在通过整合问责制、战略愿景、人力资源发展和技术创新等管理原则来加强卫生系统。
AI.research_question: 如何从管理学视角解决孟加拉国卫生系统面临的系统性挑战，并提出可持续的改革路线图？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国卫生部门面临治理薄弱、熟练劳动力短缺、资金不足、资源管理不善和服务质量差等根深蒂固的挑战，尽管妇幼健康指标有所改善，但系统效率低下阻碍了进展，需要管理导向的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Khaled (2025)的管理学理论框架，强调战略规划、制度纪律、领导能力和组织效率在改善政府部门中的作用，整合问责制、战略愿景、人力资源发展和技术创新等管理原则。
AI.method: 采用管理学视角分析，结合实践经验、学术研究和公共部门管理视角的教训，进行系统性挑战识别和管理导向解决方案设计。
AI.findings: 识别了孟加拉国卫生系统的主要问题：治理薄弱、熟练劳动力短缺、资金不足、资源管理不善、服务质量差等系统性挑战，这些挑战相互关联并阻碍卫生系统进步。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Khaled (2025)的管理学理论框架应用于卫生部门改革，扩展了公共部门管理理论在发展中国家卫生系统的应用，提供了管理学视角分析卫生系统挑战的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了结构化的、可实施的管理导向改革路线图，包括改善服务提供、加强治理结构、提高资源利用效率和增强公众对公共卫生机构的信任等具体建议，为政策制定者提供实用指导。

title: Teachers' Perspectives on the Use of AI Detection Tools: Insights from Ridge Regression Analysis
affiliations: Pampanga State Agricultural University, Pampanga, Philippines, Laguna State Polytechnic University, Pampanga State Agricultural University, Pampanga, Philippines, Pampanga State Agricultural University, Pampanga, Philippines, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Pampanga State Agricultural University, Pampanga, Philippines, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Pampanga State Agricultural University, Pampanga, Philippines and Don Honorio Ventura State University

detail.title: Teachers' Perspectives on the Use of AI Detection Tools: Insights from Ridge Regression Analysis
detail.abstract: This study explores the perceptions of 213 Filipino teachers toward AI detection tools in academic settings. It focuses on the factors that influence teachers' trust, concerns, and decision-making regarding these tools. The research investigates how teachers' trust in AI detection tools affects their perceptions of fairness and decision-making in evaluating student outputs. It also explores how concerns about AI tools and social norms influence the relationship between trust and decision-making. Ridge Regression analysis was used to examine the relationships between the predictors and the dependent variable. The results revealed that trust in AI detection tools is the most significant predictor of perceived fairness and decision-making among teachers. Concerns about AI tools and social norms have weaker effects on teachers' perceptions. The study emphasized critical role of trust in shaping teachers' perceptions of AI detection tools. Teachers who trust these tools are more likely to view them as fair and effective. In contrast, concerns and social norms have a limited influence on perceptions and decisionmaking. For recommendations, training and institutional guidelines should emphasize how these tools work, their limitations, and best practices for their use. Striking a balance between policy enforcement and educator support is essential for fostering trust in AI detection technologies. Encouraging experienced users to share insights through communities of practice could enhance the adoption and effective use of AI detection tools in educational settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了213名菲律宾教师对学术环境中AI检测工具的看法，发现信任是影响教师感知公平性和决策的最重要因素，而担忧和社会规范的影响较弱。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾教师对AI检测工具的信任、担忧和决策如何影响他们对这些工具公平性的感知？担忧和社会规范如何调节信任与决策之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 随着AI检测工具在教育环境中的广泛应用，了解教师对这些技术的态度和影响因素对于有效实施至关重要，特别是在菲律宾这样的教育环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术接受模型、信任理论和规范影响理论，探讨教师对AI工具的信任、担忧和社会规范如何影响其感知和决策。
AI.method: 对213名菲律宾教师进行问卷调查，使用岭回归分析探讨预测变量与因变量之间的关系。
AI.findings: 信任是影响教师感知公平性和决策的最显著预测因素；担忧和社会规范对教师感知的影响较弱；信任AI检测工具的教师更可能认为这些工具公平有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了教育环境中技术接受理论，强调了信任在AI工具采纳中的核心作用，为理解教师对新兴教育技术的态度提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议通过培训、制度指南和社区实践来增强教师对AI检测工具的信任，平衡政策执行与教育者支持，促进AI检测工具在教育环境中的有效采用。

title: Mixed Membership Estimation in Two-Path Partial Correlation Network Model

detail.title: Mixed Membership Estimation in Two-Path Partial Correlation Network Model
detail.abstract: We propose a novel two-path partial correlation network model (2PPCN) for learning mixed membership structures in panel data. The model assumes a joint distribution governed by a Bayesian belief network, enabling probabilistic reasoning over dependencies. In the 2PPCN framework, the interaction structure and interaction intensity are captured through two different pathways, allowing for richer representation of heterogeneous relationships. We develop the PartiaCorr-mixed-SCORE algorithm to estimate mixed memberships under the 2PPCN structure. We establish the consistency of the proposed method and demonstrate its effectiveness in simulated study. Finally, we apply our approach to U.S. state-level employment growth data to uncover latent industry-based mixed membership structures across states in U.S.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的两路径偏相关网络模型（2PPCN），用于学习面板数据中的混合成员结构。该模型采用贝叶斯信念网络控制联合分布，通过两个不同路径捕捉交互结构和交互强度，并开发了PartiaCorr-mixed-SCORE算法进行估计。方法在模拟研究中表现良好，并成功应用于美国州级就业增长数据分析。
AI.research_question: 如何从面板数据中学习混合成员结构？具体而言，如何开发一个能够同时捕捉交互结构和交互强度的网络模型来识别数据中的异质性关系模式？
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理面板数据中的复杂依赖关系和异质性结构方面存在局限，特别是在捕捉混合成员结构（即实体可能同时属于多个潜在类别）方面。需要开发更灵活的模型来同时建模交互结构和强度，以更好地理解现实世界中的复杂关系模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯信念网络的两路径偏相关网络模型（2PPCN）框架，该框架将交互结构和交互强度分离到两个不同路径中，允许对异质性关系进行更丰富的表示。模型假设数据服从由贝叶斯网络控制的联合分布。
AI.method: 开发了PartiaCorr-mixed-SCORE算法来估计2PPCN结构下的混合成员结构。该方法通过两个路径分别建模交互结构和强度，并建立了方法的理论一致性保证。
AI.findings: 模拟研究证明了所提出方法的有效性，理论分析建立了估计的一致性。在美国州级就业增长数据的应用中，该方法成功揭示了各州基于产业的潜在混合成员结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了新颖的两路径偏相关网络模型（2PPCN）框架；2）开发了PartiaCorr-mixed-SCORE估计算法；3）建立了估计方法的一致性理论保证；4）扩展了混合成员结构学习的方法论工具箱。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为分析面板数据中的复杂依赖关系提供了实用工具；2）能够识别实体（如美国各州）的混合成员结构；3）在就业增长数据分析中展示了实际应用价值；4）方法可推广到其他社会经济数据分析领域。

detail.abstract: The accelerating climate and biodiversity crises demand solutions that are sustainable, inclusive, and equitable. Gender, shaping vulnerabilities, capacities, and decision power, fundamentally determines how communities experience environmental risks and mobilize responses. Women and gender diverse people lead as decision makers, resource stewards, scientists, and activists, yet face persistent barriers to access, participation, recognition, and safety across environmental sectors. This topical collection examines how gendered disparities influence environmental outcomes, how women's leadership strengthens environmental governance, and how gender mainstreaming in sustainability science advances social justice and climate resilience. We invite empirical studies, comparative analyses, and practice frameworks from diverse regions and disciplines with clear linkages to Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 4.5 (equal access), SDG 5.5 (leadership participation), SDG 10.2 (inclusion), and SDG 13.3 (climate education and capacity). Priority themes include gendered impacts of climate change, institutional pathways for women's and gender diverse leadership, mainstreaming instruments in curricula and research such as authorship transparency, equitable fieldwork, and mentoring architectures, and community engaged case studies. By convening global perspectives and actionable evidence, the collection advances rigorous scholarship and practice to normalize gender responsive environmental governance and build resilient futures.

AI.tldr: 该专题文集探讨性别如何影响环境结果，女性领导力如何加强环境治理，以及性别主流化如何促进社会正义和气候韧性。文集邀请与SDG 4.5、5.5、10.2、13.3相关的实证研究、比较分析和实践框架。
AI.research_question: 1. 性别差异如何影响环境结果？2. 女性领导力如何加强环境治理？3. 可持续发展科学中的性别主流化如何促进社会正义和气候韧性？
AI.motivation: 气候和生物多样性危机加速，需要可持续、包容和公平的解决方案。性别塑造了脆弱性、能力和决策权，从根本上决定了社区如何经历环境风险和动员应对措施。虽然女性和性别多样化人群在决策者、资源管理者、科学家和活动家方面发挥领导作用，但在环境领域仍面临获取、参与、认可和安全方面的持续障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别与环境治理理论、社会正义理论、气候韧性理论、可持续发展目标框架（特别是SDG 4.5、5.5、10.2、13.3）、性别主流化理论、包容性领导力理论。
AI.method: 专题文集方法：邀请实证研究、比较分析、实践框架，涵盖不同地区和学科。优先主题包括气候变化对性别的影响、女性和性别多样化领导力的制度路径、课程和研究中的主流化工具（如作者透明度、公平的实地工作、指导架构）以及社区参与的案例研究。
AI.findings: 这是专题文集的征稿启事，尚未有具体研究发现。但预期通过汇集全球视角和可操作的证据，文集将推进严谨的学术和实践，使性别响应的环境治理正常化并建设有韧性的未来。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化性别与环境治理关系的理论理解；2. 扩展性别主流化在可持续发展科学中的应用理论；3. 构建性别响应环境治理的理论框架；4. 连接社会正义理论与气候韧性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供性别响应环境治理的实际工具和方法；2. 为政策制定者提供基于证据的指导；3. 促进环境领域的性别平等实践；4. 支持SDG目标的实现；5. 建立全球性别与环境治理实践社区。

title: Paternalistic Social Assistance: Evidence and Implications from Cash vs. In-Kind Transfers
affiliations: Mount Sinai Health System - Icahn School of Medicine, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Paternalistic Social Assistance: Evidence and Implications from Cash vs. In-Kind Transfers

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-145
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We estimate and compare impacts of cash and in-kind transfers on the consumption of temptation goods in the same population, and explore normative implications. We use two decades of data from South Carolina on cash benefits from Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and in-kind benefits from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) linked to detailed data on adults' health care use. Our empirical strategy examines outcome changes in the several days following each transfer's scheduled monthly payout. Emergency department visits for drug and alcohol use increase by 20-30 percent following SSI receipt, but do not respond to SNAP receipt. Fills of prescription drugs for new illnesses also increase following SSI receipt but do not respond to SNAP receipt. Motivated by these non-fungibility results, we develop a model of a paternalistic social planner choosing the mix of cash and SNAP for a fixed-budget transfer program when consumers have self-control problems and may engage in mental accounting. We show that the planner's optimal SNAP share is strictly positive and weakly increasing as self-control worsens. Moreover, with heterogeneity in self-control and mental accounting, the planner may choose to use SNAP even when they have access to a uniform Pigouvian tax on the temptation good.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了现金转移支付（SSI）和实物转移支付（SNAP）对诱惑品消费的影响，发现现金转移导致毒品和酒精相关的急诊就诊增加20-30%，而实物转移则无此效应。基于这些非替代性结果，研究者建立了一个父爱主义社会规划者模型，证明即使存在统一的庇古税，规划者仍应使用实物转移，且随着自控能力恶化，实物转移比例应增加。
AI.research_question: 现金转移支付（SSI）和实物转移支付（SNAP）对诱惑品消费的影响有何差异？在存在自控问题和心理账户的情况下，社会规划者应如何设计转移支付项目的现金与实物组合？
AI.motivation: 理解现金和实物转移支付对诱惑品消费的不同影响，为政策制定者设计更有效的社会福利项目提供依据，特别是在消费者存在自控问题和心理账户行为的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合行为经济学理论，包括自控问题（自我控制失败）、心理账户（非替代性）、父爱主义社会规划者模型，以及传统的庇古税理论。
AI.method: 使用南卡罗来纳州二十年的行政数据，将SSI现金福利和SNAP实物福利与详细的医疗使用数据关联。采用事件研究方法，分析每次转移支付月度发放后几天的结果变化。
AI.findings: 1. SSI现金转移支付后，毒品和酒精相关的急诊就诊增加20-30%，而SNAP实物转移支付无此效应；2. SSI支付后新疾病处方药使用也增加，但SNAP支付无此效应；3. 现金和实物转移支付在消费行为上表现出明显的非替代性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了考虑自控问题和心理账户的父爱主义社会规划者模型；2. 证明即使存在统一的庇古税，规划者仍应使用实物转移支付；3. 发现随着消费者自控能力恶化，最优的SNAP份额应增加；4. 为行为公共经济学提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计社会福利项目提供了实证依据；2. 建议在转移支付项目中增加实物转移比例，特别是针对自控能力较弱的群体；3. 为减少诱惑品消费相关的负面社会后果提供了政策工具；4. 为评估不同转移支付形式的有效性提供了方法论参考。

title: Social Dynamics of AI Adoption

detail.title: Social Dynamics of AI Adoption

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-144
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Anxiety about falling behind can drive people to embrace emerging technologies with uncertain consequences. We study how social forces shape demand for AI-based learning tools early in the education pipeline. In incentivized experiments with parents-key gatekeepers for children's AI adoption-we elicit their demand for unrestricted AI tools for teenagers' education. Parental demand rises with the share of other teenagers using the technology, with social forces increasing willingness to pay for AI by more than 60%. Providing information about potentially adverse effects of unstructured AI use negatively shifts beliefs about the merits of AI, but does not change individual demand. Instead, this information increases parents' preference for banning AI in schools. Follow-up experiments show that social information has little effect on beliefs about AI quality, perceived skill priorities, or support for bans, suggesting that effects operate through social pressure rather than social learning. Our evidence highlights social pressure driving individual technology adoption despite widespread support for restricting its use.

AI.tldr: 父母对AI教育工具的需求受社会压力驱动而非理性评估，即使知道AI潜在负面影响仍不会减少个人使用，但会支持学校禁用AI。
AI.research_question: 社会力量如何影响教育早期阶段AI学习工具的需求？父母作为孩子AI采用的关键把关者，其需求如何受社会因素影响？
AI.motivation: 担心落后会驱使人们接受后果不确定的新兴技术。研究社会力量如何塑造教育早期AI工具需求，父母作为关键决策者的行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会压力理论、技术采纳理论、社会学习理论、信息处理与决策理论
AI.method: 激励实验（incentivized experiments），以父母为研究对象，通过实验设计测量AI工具需求、社会信息影响、负面信息干预效果
AI.findings: 1. 父母对AI工具需求随其他青少年使用比例上升而增加，社会力量使支付意愿提高60%以上；2. 提供AI非结构化使用负面信息会改变对AI优点的信念，但不改变个人需求；3. 负面信息增加父母支持学校禁用AI的倾向；4. 社会信息对AI质量信念、技能优先级认知或禁令支持影响很小，表明效应主要通过社会压力而非社会学习
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示社会压力在技术采纳中的核心作用；2. 区分社会压力与社会学习的不同机制；3. 解释"个人使用vs集体限制"的矛盾行为模式；4. 拓展教育技术采纳理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育政策制定者提供AI监管依据；2. 帮助学校理解家长行为动机；3. 为技术公司设计推广策略提供参考；4. 揭示社会规范在技术扩散中的重要性

title: Green Transition in the Euro Area: Domestic and Global Factors
affiliations: Banque Centrale du Luxembourg, Bank of Slovenia, De Nederlandsche Bank, Central Bank of Cyprus and Banco de España

detail.title: Green Transition in the Euro Area: Domestic and Global Factors

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2537
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We explore the macroeconomic effects of climate policies promoting the green energy transition in the euro area using an extended version of the Euro Area and Global Economy (EAGLE) model. The model differentiates between brown and green energy sectors and incorporates carbon taxes and brown capital income taxes. We analyze scenarios with unilateral and globally coordinated carbon taxes, with and without revenue redistribution to green firms and financially constrained households. Carbon taxes act as negative supply shocks, raising inflation and lowering output, while subsidies to green energy firms reduce green energy prices, supporting the transition and easing recessions. Redistribution to constrained households boosts consumption but does not accelerate the green transition. Taxes on brown capital income lower both inflation and output by acting as demand shocks. Recycling revenue from this tax to subsidize green capital investment strengthens the shift to green energy and moderates economic contractions. Global coordination of carbon taxes delivers only modest additional macroeconomic effects compared with unilateral action, as substitution in energy use outweighs international spillovers. Sensitivity analyses confirm the robustness of these findings under alternative assumptions about price rigidity, substitution elasticities and monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用扩展的EAGLE模型分析欧元区绿色能源转型气候政策的宏观经济效应，探讨碳税、棕色资本收入税及其收入再分配政策的影响，发现碳税作为负供给冲击会推高通胀降低产出，而绿色补贴能缓解衰退，全球协调碳税相比单边行动效果有限。
AI.research_question: 欧元区绿色能源转型气候政策（碳税、棕色资本收入税及其收入再分配）对宏观经济（产出、通胀、消费等）有何影响？全球协调碳税相比单边行动是否带来显著额外效果？
AI.motivation: 应对气候变化需要向绿色能源转型，但相关政策（如碳税）可能带来宏观经济成本（如通胀上升、产出下降）。理解这些政策的宏观经济效应及其缓解机制（如收入再分配）对于政策设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于扩展的Euro Area and Global Economy (EAGLE)模型，区分棕色与绿色能源部门，纳入碳税、棕色资本收入税、收入再分配（补贴绿色企业、转移支付给财务约束家庭）等政策工具。
AI.method: 使用扩展的EAGLE动态随机一般均衡模型进行情景分析，比较单边与全球协调碳税、有无收入再分配等不同政策组合，并进行敏感性分析（价格粘性、替代弹性、货币政策等假设）。
AI.findings: 1. 碳税作为负供给冲击推高通胀、降低产出；2. 补贴绿色企业降低绿色能源价格，支持转型并缓解衰退；3. 再分配给约束家庭促进消费但不加速绿色转型；4. 棕色资本收入税作为需求冲击同时降低通胀和产出；5. 用该税收补贴绿色资本投资能加强转型并缓和经济收缩；6. 全球协调碳税相比单边行动效果有限（能源替代效应超过国际溢出）。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展EAGLE模型以分析绿色转型政策的宏观经济效应，明确区分碳税（供给冲击）与棕色资本收入税（需求冲击）的不同传导机制，揭示收入再分配政策在缓解转型成本中的作用差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供设计绿色转型政策的依据：1. 碳税需配合绿色补贴以缓解衰退；2. 棕色资本收入税收入应用于补贴绿色投资而非家庭转移支付；3. 全球协调碳税的额外收益有限，单边行动也可取得大部分效果。

title: Prevalence, Devices Used, Reasons for Use, Trust, Barriers, and Challenges in Utilizing Generative AI among Tertiary Students
affiliations: Don Honorio Ventura State University, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Don Honorio Ventura State University, Don Honorio Ventura State University and Don Honorio Ventura State University

detail.title: Prevalence, Devices Used, Reasons for Use, Trust, Barriers, and Challenges in Utilizing Generative AI among Tertiary Students
detail.abstract: This study examined generative AI usage among Philippine college students particularly on frequency, devices, reasons, knowledge, trust, perceptions, and challenges. Most students used free AI tools on smartphones due to financial constraints. They used it primarily for homework, idea generation, and research. Less than half felt confident with AI and expressed mixed feelings about its accuracy. Barriers included limited access, lack of teacher support, difficulty understanding outputs, and financial constraints. The study highlighted the need for better access, support, training, and ethical guidelines. Broader concerns included impacts on learning, academic standards, job loss, and privacy. Students viewed AI positively due to peer support. Recommendations are discussed.

AI.tldr: 菲律宾大学生使用生成式AI的研究：主要使用免费工具和手机，主要用于作业、创意和研究，但存在信心不足、准确性担忧、访问限制、教师支持不足等障碍，需要更好的支持、培训和伦理指导。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾大学生使用生成式AI的频率、设备、原因、知识水平、信任度、感知和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解菲律宾大学生使用生成式AI的现状，识别使用模式、障碍和影响，为教育政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型、数字鸿沟理论、教育技术整合理论
AI.method: 调查研究方法，收集菲律宾大学生使用生成式AI的数据，分析使用频率、设备、原因、知识、信任、感知和挑战
AI.findings: 大多数学生使用免费的AI工具和智能手机，主要用于作业、创意生成和研究；不到一半的学生对AI有信心，对其准确性持混合态度；障碍包括访问限制、缺乏教师支持、理解输出困难和财务约束
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术接受模型在发展中国家的应用，揭示了数字鸿沟在AI使用中的具体表现，丰富了教育技术整合理论在生成式AI背景下的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构提供改进AI访问、支持、培训和伦理指导的建议；帮助政策制定者应对AI对学习、学术标准、就业和隐私的影响；为教师提供支持学生使用AI的指导

detail.abstract: To address the complex challenges in international development, the role of social enterprises, particularly social ventures, is increasingly vital. These enterprises employ innovative and sustainable approaches to tackle multifaceted issues, by blending social objectives with economic gain and bridging corporate structures and nonprofit organizations. They offer effective solutions to development challenges through innovative approaches and technological integration, fostering a close collaboration with marginalized communities and local groups in developing countries. Nevertheless, activities and studies on the role of social enterprises in international development, especially in terms of individual corporate activities, remain limited due to institutional constraints and scarcity of information available. This study focuses on the features of social enterprises to illustrate their roles and contributions within the context of international development cooperation. By focusing on social ventures as the main form of social enterprise in international development, this study attempts to move beyond previous limitations and yield practical insights on facilitating the participation of social enterprises in international development, and to increase their impact. (The rest omitted.)

title: From Symmetry-Breaking to Causality: A Definite Framework for Causal Inference *
affiliations: Westlake University, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences and Jinan University

detail.title: From Symmetry-Breaking to Causality: A Definite Framework for Causal Inference *
detail.abstract: The core impediment to causal inference lies in a profound symmetry. In the foundational model Y = X + e, the causal direction between X and Y becomes statistically unidentifiable when both terms are normally distributed, creating a long-standing philosophical and technical stalemate. This paper presents a resolution by moving from symmetry to asymmetry. We introduce a novel framework that, through an asymmetric transformation based on Generalized Measures of Correlation (GMC), establishes a definite causal link. This approach provides, for the first time, a necessary and sufficient condition to ascertain the direction from X to Y , resolving the identifiability problem at its most elementary level. Moreover, we prove that this inference is not merely definite, but also optimal under the Minimum Mean Squared Prediction Error (MMSPE) principle. We will present extensive evidence of its superior performance across  diverse fields. Finally, the paper will explore how this framework facilitates causal discovery in large and high dimension datasets and points toward a new type causal relationship, inviting a fresh philosophical examination of causality itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解决因果推断中对称性问题的创新框架，通过基于广义相关度量(GMC)的非对称变换，首次为X→Y方向提供了充分必要条件，解决了最基本的可识别性问题。
AI.research_question: 在Y = X + e模型中，当X和e都服从正态分布时，如何确定X和Y之间的因果方向？
AI.motivation: 因果推断的核心障碍在于对称性问题：在基础模型Y = X + e中，当X和e都服从正态分布时，因果方向在统计上无法识别，这造成了长期存在的哲学和技术僵局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于广义相关度量(GMC)的非对称变换框架，最小均方预测误差(MMSPE)原理。
AI.method: 通过GMC的非对称变换建立明确的因果联系，为X→Y方向提供充分必要条件，并证明该推断在MMSPE原则下是最优的。
AI.findings: 1) 首次解决了最基本的因果方向可识别性问题；2) 该推断不仅是确定的，而且在MMSPE原则下是最优的；3) 在多个领域表现出优越性能；4) 能够促进大规模高维数据集中的因果发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 从对称性转向非对称性的理论突破；2) 为因果方向提供了充分必要条件；3) 建立了最优因果推断的理论基础；4) 为因果关系的哲学思考提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了实际可操作的因果方向判断方法；2) 适用于大规模高维数据集；3) 在多个领域具有应用价值；4) 为因果发现提供了新的技术工具。

title: The Entropy of Excellence

detail.title: The Entropy of Excellence
detail.abstract: This paper presents the Unified Operating Model (UOM), integrating Robert Simons' research on entrepreneurial gaps with Moral Tipping Point (MTP) Theory to create a comprehensive framework for organizational pressure management. The core insight is that pressure is an amplifier, not a driver; what matters is what exists beneath it. The model establishes that ethical and operational failures divide into distinct categories requiring different interventions: functional duress-driven failures respond to enablement, identity duress-driven failures respond to signal architecture, and opportunism-driven failures respond to scrutiny. Organizations struggle when they misallocate these levers. This revised edition integrates Signal Architecture as a fourth intervention lever, adds Gate 0 (Identity Duress Risk Assessment) to the implementation sequence, and provides explicit treatment of interaction effects between failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一运营模型（UOM），整合Robert Simons的企业家缺口研究和道德临界点理论，创建组织压力管理框架。核心观点是压力是放大器而非驱动力，关键在于压力下的内容。模型将伦理和运营失败分为不同类别，需要不同的干预措施：功能胁迫驱动的失败需要赋能，身份胁迫驱动的失败需要信号架构，机会主义驱动的失败需要审查。组织在错误分配这些杠杆时会遇到困难。
AI.research_question: 如何创建一个综合框架来有效管理组织压力，并针对不同类型的伦理和运营失败提供适当的干预措施？
AI.motivation: 组织在压力管理方面面临挑战，经常错误分配干预措施，导致伦理和运营失败。现有理论缺乏对压力本质（作为放大器而非驱动力）的深入理解，以及针对不同类型失败的具体干预策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合Robert Simons的企业家缺口研究和道德临界点（MTP）理论，构建统一运营模型（UOM）。
AI.method: 理论整合与框架开发方法，通过整合现有理论构建综合模型，并加入新的干预杠杆（信号架构）和实施序列（Gate 0）。
AI.findings: 1. 压力是放大器而非驱动力；2. 伦理和运营失败分为三类：功能胁迫驱动、身份胁迫驱动、机会主义驱动；3. 每类失败需要不同的干预措施：赋能、信号架构、审查；4. 组织在错误分配这些杠杆时会遇到困难。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出统一运营模型（UOM）作为组织压力管理的综合框架；2. 整合企业家缺口研究和道德临界点理论；3. 引入信号架构作为第四干预杠杆；4. 增加Gate 0（身份胁迫风险评估）到实施序列；5. 明确处理失败模式间的交互效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供诊断工具，识别不同类型的组织失败；2. 提供针对性的干预策略：赋能、信号架构、审查；3. 帮助组织避免错误分配干预措施；4. 通过Gate 0评估身份胁迫风险；5. 理解失败模式间的交互效应，提高干预效果。

title: The Drowning Curve

detail.title: The Drowning Curve
detail.abstract: Moral Tipping Point Theory (MTP) provides a mathematical and behavioral framework for understanding why people fail ethically and what interventions actually work. The core insight is that ethical failure has two fundamentally different modes, opportunism-driven and duress-driven, and each requires a different organizational response. This revised edition introduces a key refinement: duress itself divides into two subtypes with different saturation properties and intervention requirements. Functional Duress (D f) arises from external pressure and responds to enablement. Identity Duress (D i) arises from threat to perceived competence and responds to signal architecture: changing what an action means rather than how hard it is. Many organizations treat all failure as an observation problem: "If we tracked it better, people would behave." This is true for opportunism-driven failure, where surveillance raises the cost of taking. It is largely ineffective for duress-driven failure, where surveillance adds stress without reducing the underlying friction that causes the failure.

AI.tldr: 道德临界点理论（MTP）提供了一个数学和行为框架，解释人们为何道德失败以及哪些干预措施真正有效。核心观点是道德失败有两种根本不同的模式：机会主义驱动和胁迫驱动，每种都需要不同的组织应对。修订版引入了关键改进：胁迫本身分为两种亚型，具有不同的饱和特性和干预要求。
AI.research_question: 人们为什么会道德失败？什么样的干预措施能够有效应对不同类型的道德失败？组织应该如何区分和应对机会主义驱动与胁迫驱动的道德失败？
AI.motivation: 许多组织将道德失败视为观察问题，认为"如果我们更好地追踪，人们就会表现良好"。这种观点只适用于机会主义驱动的失败，但对胁迫驱动的失败效果有限，因为监控会增加压力而不减少导致失败的根本摩擦。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德临界点理论（MTP）提供了理解道德失败的数学和行为框架。核心理论包括：1）道德失败的两种根本模式：机会主义驱动和胁迫驱动；2）胁迫进一步分为功能胁迫（Df）和身份胁迫（Di）；3）每种失败类型需要不同的干预策略。
AI.method: 该论文采用理论框架构建方法，基于数学和行为科学原理，通过概念分析和理论推导，建立道德临界点理论。修订版通过引入胁迫亚型的区分来完善原有理论框架。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）机会主义驱动的道德失败可以通过监控提高"获取"成本来有效应对；2）胁迫驱动的道德失败需要不同的干预措施；3）功能胁迫源于外部压力，可通过赋能来应对；4）身份胁迫源于感知能力威胁，需要通过信号架构来改变行动意义而非难度。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）提出道德临界点理论（MTP）的完整框架；2）将胁迫驱动的道德失败细分为功能胁迫和身份胁迫；3）为不同类型的道德失败提供针对性的干预理论；4）挑战了将道德失败统一视为观察问题的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）帮助组织识别道德失败的根本原因；2）为不同类型的道德失败提供针对性的干预策略；3）避免对胁迫驱动的失败使用无效的监控措施；4）通过信号架构设计来应对身份胁迫，改变行动的意义而非难度。

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-060
title: Do Energy-Saving Nudges Deliver During High-Price Periods? Field Experimental Evidence from the European Energy Crisis
affiliations: Paderborn University,  and VU University Amsterdam

detail.title: Do Energy-Saving Nudges Deliver During High-Price Periods? Field Experimental Evidence from the European Energy Crisis

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-060
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Urged by the European Energy Crisis and the threatening consequences of severe natural gas shortages, energy providers launched gas-saving initiatives incorporating financial incentives to reduce residential natural gas consumption. In collaboration with one of Germany's largest energy providers, we conducted a natural field experiment (N = 2,598) to evaluate the effectiveness of a behaviorally-guided co-design of such a gas-saving initiative by implementing two established behavioral instruments-reminders of gas saving intentions and descriptive norm feedback. Our findings show limited effectiveness of the behavioral instruments during the high-price period. The feedback risks a "boomerang effect" among households with above-average initial savings, who reduce their conservation efforts in response. The reminder does not significantly enhance savings in our main specifications, yet, realizes 1 percentage point savings in alternate models refining for outliers. Potential mechanisms include a significant intentionaction gap and misperceived effectiveness of energy-saving actions, which are not alleviated by the reminder.

AI.tldr: 研究通过实地实验评估行为干预措施（提醒和反馈）对居民天然气节约的效果，发现行为工具在高价格时期效果有限，反馈可能对高节约家庭产生"回旋镖效应"，提醒仅在特定模型中有微弱效果。
AI.research_question: 行为干预措施（提醒和反馈）在激励居民节约天然气消费方面是否有效？
AI.motivation: 欧洲能源危机和天然气短缺威胁促使能源供应商推出节能激励计划，需要评估行为干预措施在促进居民天然气节约方面的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论，包括意图-行动差距理论、描述性规范反馈理论、提醒干预理论。
AI.method: 与德国大型能源供应商合作的自然实地实验，样本量N=2,598，实施两种行为干预：节约意图提醒和描述性规范反馈。
AI.findings: 1. 行为工具在高价格时期效果有限；2. 反馈对初始节约水平高于平均的家庭产生"回旋镖效应"，反而降低节约努力；3. 提醒在主模型中无显著效果，但在剔除异常值的替代模型中实现1个百分点的节约；4. 存在显著的意图-行动差距和节能行动效果误判，提醒未能缓解这些问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了行为干预在能源危机高价格环境下的局限性；2. 发现了描述性规范反馈可能产生的"回旋镖效应"；3. 验证了意图-行动差距在能源节约行为中的存在。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为能源供应商设计节能计划提供实证依据；2. 警示反馈干预可能对高节约家庭产生负面效果；3. 建议需要更有效的干预措施来弥补意图-行动差距。

title: Investigation of the Dimensions of Structures, Patterns, and historical Experiences from the Perspective of Nahj al-Balaghah: A Thematic Analysis Approach
affiliations: , Research Institute of Hawzah and University and Research Institute of Hawzah and University

detail.title: Investigation of the Dimensions of Structures, Patterns, and historical Experiences from the Perspective of Nahj al-Balaghah: A Thematic Analysis Approach
detail.abstract: The historical sociology studies highlighted specific dimensions of the structures and patterns of social change. On their basis, groups or organizations have chosen or embarked on different paths in the history. Imam Ali (AS) introduced what happened in the past as a source of knowledge and emphasized its determining role and using it in the right path in life. This research tried to answer the question of how Imam Ali (AS) contemplated this issue and what is his social interpretation of the use of historical experiences. For this purpose, referring to direct and indirect statements related to the historical experience in Nahj al-Balaghah, initially, the extracted propositions resulted in a total of 159 initial codes constructing a network of themes. Research findings, obtained from the analysis of primary codes, indicated four main themes: a) consequences of neglecting reason, experiences, and advice; b) general historical patterns and role patterns; c) historical lessons; and d) recommendations using historical experiences that cover other major categories.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了伊玛目阿里在《辞章之道》中关于历史经验的论述，识别出159个初始代码并归纳为四个主要主题：忽视理性、经验和建议的后果；一般历史模式和角色模式；历史教训；以及使用历史经验的建议。
AI.research_question: 伊玛目阿里如何思考历史经验问题？他对使用历史经验的社会解释是什么？
AI.motivation: 历史社会学研究强调社会变化结构和模式的特定维度，基于此，群体或组织在历史上选择了不同的路径。伊玛目阿里将过去发生的事情视为知识来源，强调其在生活中的决定性作用以及正确使用历史经验的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史社会学理论，伊玛目阿里的社会思想，历史经验的社会解释框架。
AI.method: 通过分析《辞章之道》中与历史经验相关的直接和间接陈述，提取命题形成159个初始代码，构建主题网络，进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现四个主要主题：1)忽视理性、经验和建议的后果；2)一般历史模式和角色模式；3)历史教训；4)使用历史经验的建议，这些主题覆盖了其他主要类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 为历史社会学提供了基于伊玛目阿里思想的独特视角，丰富了历史经验的社会解释理论框架，建立了宗教文本分析与社会科学研究的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人和组织如何从历史经验中学习提供实践指导，帮助避免重复历史错误，促进社会发展的正确路径选择。

title: Mechanism Design with Spiteful Agents
affiliations: Ashoka University, Ben Gurion University of the Negev and Tel Aviv University

detail.title: Mechanism Design with Spiteful Agents
detail.abstract: We study a mechanism-design problem in which spiteful agents strive to not only maximize their rewards but also, contingent upon their own payoff levels, seek to lower the opponents' rewards. We characterize all individually rational (IR) and incentivecompatible (IC) mechanisms that are immune to such spiteful behavior, showing that they take the form of threshold mechanisms with an ordering of the agents. Building on this characterization, we prove two impossibility results: under either anonymity or efficiency, any such IR and IC mechanism collapses to the null mechanism, which never allocates the item to any agent. Leveraging these findings, we partially extend our analysis to a multi-item setup. These results illuminate the challenges of auctioning items in the natural presence of other-regarding preferences.

AI.tldr: 研究带有嫉妒心理的代理人在机制设计中的问题，发现只有阈值机制能同时满足个体理性和激励相容，但在匿名性或效率要求下会退化为空机制，揭示了其他关注偏好在拍卖中的挑战。
AI.research_question: 在存在嫉妒心理（代理人不仅追求自身收益最大化，还试图降低对手收益）的情况下，什么样的机制设计能够同时满足个体理性（IR）和激励相容（IC）？
AI.motivation: 现实中的代理人往往具有"其他关注偏好"（other-regarding preferences），包括嫉妒心理，这会破坏传统机制设计的有效性。研究这种自然存在的心理因素对拍卖机制的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、个体理性（IR）、激励相容（IC）、嫉妒偏好（spiteful preferences）、其他关注偏好理论、阈值机制理论
AI.method: 理论分析：首先刻画所有满足IR和IC且能抵御嫉妒行为的机制形式，然后证明在匿名性或效率要求下的不可能性结果，最后将分析部分扩展到多物品设置。
AI.findings: 1. 所有满足IR和IC且能抵御嫉妒行为的机制都采取带有代理人排序的阈值机制形式；2. 在匿名性或效率要求下，任何这样的IR和IC机制都会退化为空机制（从不分配物品）；3. 这些结果可以部分扩展到多物品设置。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析了嫉妒偏好下的机制设计问题；2. 刻画了抵御嫉妒行为的机制形式特征；3. 证明了在匿名性或效率约束下的不可能性定理；4. 为其他关注偏好的机制设计理论提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示了现实拍卖中考虑嫉妒心理的重要性；2. 表明传统拍卖机制在存在嫉妒偏好时可能失效；3. 为设计更符合实际心理的拍卖机制提供了理论指导；4. 提醒机制设计者需要考虑代理人的社会偏好。

title: Industrial Decarbonisation Frontiers Report: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
affiliations: University of Bath, Independent, Imperial College London, Heriot-Watt University, Teesside University, University of Bath, University of Lincoln (UK), The University of Manchester, University of Southampton, University of South Wales and University of South Wales

detail.title: Industrial Decarbonisation Frontiers Report: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
detail.abstract: This report synthesises IDRIC’s research on Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), highlighting its essential role in supporting industrial decarbonisation. By evaluating full environmental impacts across the entire life cycle of decarbonised technologies and systems, LCA enables industry, policymakers and technology developers to make informed, sustainable decisions that avoid unintended consequences.

AI.tldr: 该报告综合了IDRIC关于生命周期评估（LCA）的研究，强调LCA在支持工业脱碳中的关键作用。LCA通过评估脱碳技术和系统整个生命周期的全面环境影响，帮助工业界、政策制定者和技术开发者做出明智、可持续的决策，避免意外后果。
AI.research_question: 生命周期评估（LCA）如何支持工业脱碳决策，帮助避免意外环境后果？
AI.motivation: 工业脱碳需要全面的环境评估工具，以避免在追求碳减排时产生其他负面环境影响。LCA作为一种系统性的评估方法，能够为脱碳技术和系统的决策提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期评估理论框架，包括从原材料获取、生产制造、使用到废弃处理的完整生命周期分析，以及环境影响评估方法学。
AI.method: 综合研究合成方法，整合IDRIC多个关于LCA的研究项目成果，进行系统性分析和总结。
AI.findings: LCA是支持工业脱碳决策的关键工具，能够全面评估脱碳技术和系统的环境表现，帮助识别和避免潜在的意外环境后果，为可持续决策提供科学基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 强化了LCA在工业脱碳背景下的理论重要性，明确了其在避免环境问题转移和实现真正可持续转型中的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业界、政策制定者和技术开发者提供了实用的LCA应用指南，帮助他们做出更明智的脱碳技术选择和系统设计决策，促进可持续工业发展。

title: From the Black Market to Legalisation: The Causal Impact of Cannabis Reform in Morocco
affiliations: , University of Florence and

detail.title: From the Black Market to Legalisation: The Causal Impact of Cannabis Reform in Morocco

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article analyses the impact of legalising cannabis production for industrial and pharmaceutical use in Morocco, paying particular attention to reducing illegal cultivation. Using an original dataset compiled from multiple sources and employing an advanced econometric approach based on the Synthetic Control Method, the study provides robust evidence of a substantial decrease in illegal production as a consequence of the reform. The results have two main implications. First, for Morocco, regulated legalisation emerges as an effective policy tool for reducing the informal economy, with positive effects on tax revenues and international trade. For Europe, and Italy in particular, the reform introduced in the North African country creates new opportunities for the supply of medical cannabis, providing an alternative or supplementary source that could help to alleviate the ongoing shortage of cannabis intended for medical use.

AI.tldr: 摩洛哥将大麻生产合法化用于工业和医药用途，通过合成控制法分析发现该改革显著减少了非法种植，为摩洛哥带来税收和贸易收益，为欧洲（特别是意大利）提供了医疗大麻的替代供应来源。
AI.research_question: 摩洛哥将大麻生产合法化用于工业和医药用途的政策改革对减少非法种植有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究摩洛哥大麻合法化改革的实际效果，特别是其对减少非法经济、增加税收和贸易的影响，以及为欧洲医疗大麻短缺问题提供解决方案的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合成控制法的计量经济学框架，用于评估政策干预的效果；非法经济向正规经济转型的理论；医疗大麻供应链管理理论。
AI.method: 使用从多个来源编制的原始数据集，采用基于合成控制法的高级计量经济学方法进行分析。
AI.findings: 改革导致非法生产大幅减少；为摩洛哥提供了减少非正规经济的有效政策工具，对税收和国际贸易产生积极影响；为欧洲特别是意大利创造了医疗大麻供应新机会。

title: Deep Statistical Jump Models: Towards General Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Time Series Learning
affiliations: Princeton University, Princeton University - Bendheim Center for Finance and New York University (NYU) - Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences

detail.title: Deep Statistical Jump Models: Towards General Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Time Series Learning
detail.abstract: We propose a general and simple deep learning extension of Statistical Jump Models in the spirit of a Mixture-of-Experts framework. This framework is designed to ensemble neural networks via inferred latent state distributions. We detail the variants and applications of Deep Statistical Jump Models such as regime-switching factor models, end-to-end decision models, among others. We also describe how to use Block Coordinate Gradient Descent to fit this type of models and discuss practical implementation details. As part of the fitting algorithm and in order to obtain probability estimates in the state inference step, we propose a smoothed relaxation of standard Viterbi algorithm for structured state inference from discrete state labels to the probability simplex. We also apply existing theoretical framework to show convergence of the fitting algorithm and quantify the error introduced by the smoothed dynamic programming. We demonstrate the framework on synthetic data generated from a Hidden Markov Model with quadratic factor emissions and compare against classical Statistical Jump Models and disjoint modeling baselines in both supervised and unsupervised settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于混合专家框架的深度统计跳跃模型通用扩展，通过推断的隐状态分布集成神经网络，并开发了平滑动态规划算法进行状态推断。
AI.research_question: 如何将深度学习与统计跳跃模型结合，构建一个能够处理隐状态切换的通用建模框架？
AI.motivation: 传统统计跳跃模型在处理复杂非线性关系时能力有限，而深度学习虽然强大但缺乏对状态切换的显式建模能力，需要结合两者优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合专家框架、隐马尔可夫模型、统计跳跃模型、平滑动态规划理论
AI.method: 提出深度统计跳跃模型，使用块坐标梯度下降进行拟合，开发平滑Viterbi算法进行状态推断，并在合成数据上进行验证
AI.findings: 深度统计跳跃模型在监督和非监督设置下均优于传统统计跳跃模型和分离建模基线，特别是在处理二次因子发射的隐马尔可夫模型时表现更佳
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了深度统计跳跃模型的通用框架；2) 开发了平滑动态规划算法进行概率估计；3) 证明了拟合算法的收敛性并量化了平滑动态规划的误差
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了可应用于状态切换因子模型和端到端决策模型的实用框架；2) 给出了详细的实现细节；3) 展示了在合成数据上的优越性能

title: Labour History and the Economics of Natural Resources
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Labour History and the Economics of Natural Resources
detail.abstract: Labour was traditionally at the centre of historical and sociological studies of natural resource extraction. This is no longer the case as the size, visibility and collective organisation of workforces in the extractive industries - all of which captured scholarly attention - has declined. This chapter takes a long-term and global perspective on the history of labour and natural resource extraction from the early nineteenth century to the present. It identifies and described two major trends in the extractive industries: The first is the relative decline in the numbers working in extractive industries even as output has increased enormously. The second is that the racial and gender hierarchies that determined who could do what job have slowly been dismantled. Hierarchies of gender and race hardened and spread during the nineteenth century to become commonplace features of the industry.

AI.tldr: 本文从长期全球视角分析19世纪初至今自然资源开采行业中的劳动力演变，发现两大趋势：一是开采行业就业人数相对下降而产量大幅增长；二是种族和性别等级制度逐渐被打破，这些等级在19世纪曾强化并成为行业普遍特征。
AI.research_question: 从19世纪初至今，自然资源开采行业中的劳动力经历了怎样的历史演变？特别是就业规模、种族和性别等级制度如何变化？
AI.motivation: 传统上劳动力是自然资源开采研究的核心，但随着开采行业劳动力规模、可见性和集体组织的减少，学术关注度下降。本文旨在重新审视这一重要但被忽视的研究领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史社会学视角，结合劳动力研究、产业转型理论和种族/性别等级制度理论，采用长期全球比较分析框架。
AI.method: 历史比较研究方法，采用长期（19世纪初至今）和全球视角，通过历史文献分析和趋势识别来考察自然资源开采行业的劳动力演变。
AI.findings: 发现两大主要趋势：1）开采行业就业人数相对下降，而产量大幅增长，显示生产效率提高和自动化程度增加；2）19世纪强化并普及的种族和性别等级制度逐渐被打破，劳动力结构发生变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：重新将劳动力置于自然资源开采研究的中心位置，提供了长期历史视角下的劳动力演变理论框架，深化了对产业转型中社会结构变化的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为理解当代开采行业的劳动力结构变化提供历史背景，对产业政策制定、劳动力市场分析和企业人力资源管理具有参考价值，有助于认识技术进步与社会平等进程的相互作用。

title: Citywide Orchestration of Electric Vehicle Battery Swapping
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Tsinghua University and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Citywide Orchestration of Electric Vehicle Battery Swapping
detail.abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) battery swapping has been thriving, particularly in the electric ride-hailing sector; yet, operational innovation lags behind this market expansion. Current practices often adhere to rigid strategies like uniform battery stock allocation, causing severe spatial mismatches between demand and available batteries. Resolving this from the supply side proves intractable: on one hand, further increasing battery inventory is financially and environmentally prohibitive; on the other hand, repositioning bulky batteries is logistically formidable. To circumvent this impasse, we investigate a demand-side breakthrough: coordinated swapping. This innovation aligns demand with supply by proactively guiding vehicles to designated stations. This paper examines the fundamental challenges of designing a swapping station network to enable this coordination and evaluating its efficiency. Specifically, we model station operations using stochastic inventory theory and propose a two-stage distributionally robust optimization model for joint location and capacity planning. This model presents challenges due to bilinear terms and sums of piecewise linear functions in the second-stage problem. Notably, we prove the convexity of the second-stage problem and reveal a distinctive structure in its dual solution. These model properties guide us in designing efficient column-and-constraint generation algorithms. We also propose two alternative strategies and extend persistence theory in discrete optimization to reformulate them as mixed-integer second-order cone programs. We validate the efficacy of our algorithms and the performance of our proposed strategies using real transportation data from Beijing. Results indicate that coordinated swapping excels in managing spatial demand distribution due to its flexibility. These benefits amplify with lower service rates and higher grid capacity. Furthermore, enhanced grid capacity results in a spatially heterogeneous battery distribution, and ongoing technological advancements give rise to a U-shaped pattern in battery inventory size. In a broader context, this work illuminates the role of mobility-energy coordination in enabling smart cities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电动汽车电池换电网络的协调换电策略，通过需求侧引导车辆到指定换电站，解决供需空间不匹配问题。作者提出两阶段分布鲁棒优化模型进行换电站选址和容量规划，并设计高效算法。基于北京实际数据的验证表明，协调换电策略在管理空间需求分布方面表现优异。
AI.research_question: 如何设计电动汽车电池换电站网络以实现协调换电策略，并评估其运营效率？
AI.motivation: 当前电动汽车换电市场快速发展，但运营创新滞后。现有策略采用统一的电池库存分配，导致供需空间严重不匹配。从供给侧解决此问题存在财务、环境和物流上的困难，因此需要从需求侧寻找突破。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机库存理论、分布鲁棒优化理论、列与约束生成算法、混合整数二阶锥规划、离散优化中的持久性理论
AI.method: 使用随机库存理论建模换电站运营，提出两阶段分布鲁棒优化模型进行联合选址和容量规划。设计高效的列与约束生成算法，并提出两种替代策略，通过扩展持久性理论将其重构为混合整数二阶锥规划。使用北京实际交通数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 协调换电策略因其灵活性在管理空间需求分布方面表现优异。这些优势在服务率较低和电网容量较高时更加明显。增强电网容量会导致电池分布的空间异质性，而持续的技术进步会产生电池库存规模的U型模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明了第二阶段问题的凸性并揭示了其对偶解的独特结构；2) 设计了高效的列与约束生成算法；3) 扩展了离散优化中的持久性理论，将替代策略重构为混合整数二阶锥规划。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为电动汽车换电站网络设计提供了实用的优化框架；2) 提出的协调换电策略能有效解决供需空间不匹配问题；3) 研究结果为智能城市中的移动-能源协调提供了实践指导。

title: AI and its Algorithm Bias and Ethical Implications
affiliations: Carroll University

detail.title: AI and its Algorithm Bias and Ethical Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest in regards to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The authors confirm that this research did not involve human subjects, animal experiments, or the use of identifiable personal data. As such, ethical approval and informed consent were not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares that no funding has been received.

detail.abstract: This study examines the ethical challenges posed by algorithmic bias in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its implications for governance, fairness, and accountability. As AI becomes more integrated into daily life and organizational decision-making, unintentional biases from data, model design, and implementation can undermine fairness and trust. Such biases contribute to inequitable outcomes in areas like hiring, healthcare, and analytics, raising serious legal and societal concerns. The paper highlights the need for robust AI governance frameworks, including regulatory oversight, audit mechanisms, and explainable systems, to ensure accountability. Ultimately, it argues that mitigating algorithmic bias is vital for fostering responsible, transparent, and socially beneficial AI development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能算法偏见带来的伦理挑战及其对治理、公平和问责的影响，强调需要建立强大的AI治理框架来确保算法公平性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能中的算法偏见如何影响治理、公平和问责？如何通过治理框架有效缓解这些偏见？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在日常生活和组织决策中日益普及，数据、模型设计和实施中的无意偏见会破坏公平和信任，导致招聘、医疗保健和分析等领域的不公平结果，引发严重的法律和社会关切。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法公平性理论、AI伦理框架、治理理论、问责机制理论、透明度和可解释性理论
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于文献综述和理论分析，探讨算法偏见的来源、影响及治理对策
AI.findings: 算法偏见源于数据、模型设计和实施等多个环节，会导致招聘、医疗保健等关键领域的不公平结果，需要综合性的治理框架来应对
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了算法偏见与治理、公平、问责之间的理论联系，提出了AI治理框架的理论基础，丰富了算法公平性和AI伦理的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包含监管监督、审计机制和可解释系统的具体治理措施，为政策制定者、组织和技术开发者提供了缓解算法偏见的实践指导

title: Volatility, Skewness Spill-overs and the Role of News Surprises: Dynamics in Foreign Exchange Markets

detail.title: Volatility, Skewness Spill-overs and the Role of News Surprises: Dynamics in Foreign Exchange Markets
detail.abstract: This study analyses volatility and skewness spill-overs in G7, Australian, New Zealand, and Chinese currency option markets by employing a VAR framework to capture dynamic linkages between news announcement surprises, implied volatility, and skewness across five regimes: the Global Financial Crisis, European Sovereign Debt Crisis, Covid-19 Crisis, precrisis economic growth, and monetary policy normalisation. The results reveal persistent volatility spill-overs, with CAD and EUR as central risk transmitters, while CNY remains largely insulated except during periods of extreme market stress. News surprises exert limited influence except during precrisis expansion, and skewness spill-overs display regime-dependent patterns. These findings highlight the importance of regime-based policy responses and strengthened international coordination.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了G7、澳大利亚、新西兰和中国货币期权市场的波动率和偏度溢出效应，使用VAR框架捕捉五个不同经济时期（全球金融危机、欧洲主权债务危机、新冠疫情危机、危机前经济增长和货币政策正常化）中新闻公告意外、隐含波动率和偏度之间的动态关联。
AI.research_question: 在不同经济体制下，G7、澳大利亚、新西兰和中国货币期权市场之间如何发生波动率和偏度的溢出效应？新闻公告意外对这些溢出效应有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解不同经济体制下主要货币期权市场之间的风险传导机制，为政策制定者提供基于体制的应对策略依据，加强国际协调。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率溢出理论、偏度溢出理论、VAR模型框架、体制转换理论、国际金融市场联动理论。
AI.method: 采用VAR（向量自回归）框架分析五个不同经济体制下的动态关联：全球金融危机、欧洲主权债务危机、新冠疫情危机、危机前经济增长和货币政策正常化时期。
AI.findings: 1. 存在持续的波动率溢出效应，CAD和EUR是主要风险传导中心；2. CNY在大多数时期保持相对隔离，仅在极端市场压力时期受到影响；3. 新闻公告意外的影响有限，主要在危机前扩张时期显著；4. 偏度溢出效应呈现体制依赖性模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了多体制下货币期权市场波动率和偏度溢出分析框架；2. 揭示了不同货币在市场风险传导中的角色差异；3. 验证了新闻意外影响的体制依赖性；4. 拓展了国际金融市场联动理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供基于经济体制的风险管理策略；2. 强调国际协调在危机时期的重要性；3. 帮助投资者理解不同货币的风险传导特性；4. 为监管机构提供市场稳定性的监测框架。
